title: Turkey Sausage Egg White Breakfast Sandwiches
subtitle: A leaner breakfast sandwich built on turkey sausage, egg whites, and whole English muffins.
description: Turkey sausage patties and fluffy egg whites are stacked on toasted English muffins with a slice of cheese. It is a lighter take on the hall's usual breakfast sandwich, built for crews watching fat without giving up a real handheld breakfast.

steps.title: Toast the muffins
steps.instruction: Split and toast English muffins on a griddle or under the broiler until golden. Hold warm on a tray.

steps.title: Cook the turkey sausage
steps.instruction: Cook turkey sausage patties in a skillet over medium heat 4 minutes per side until browned and 165°F internal. Turkey sausage has less fat than pork, so watch closely — it can dry out if pushed too hot.

steps.title: Cook the egg whites
steps.instruction: Melt butter in a nonstick pan over medium-low. Pour in egg whites and cook gently, stirring occasionally, until just set — egg whites firm up faster than whole eggs, so pull them a little early.

steps.title: Assemble the sandwiches
steps.instruction: Layer sausage, a portion of egg whites, and cheese on the bottom muffin half. Close and hold wrapped in foil on a warm tray until served.

steps.title: Hold and serve
steps.instruction: Hold wrapped sandwiches in a 200°F oven up to 15 minutes if serving is staggered. Serve with hot sauce on the side.

stationWorkflow: Toast muffins first since they hold well wrapped while the rest finishes.
Cook sausage and egg whites in separate pans so timing for each stays accurate.
Assemble sandwiches just before service — egg whites lose their texture if they sit built too long.
cleanupNotes: Wipe the egg white pan while still warm — a nonstick surface is easiest to clean before it cools.
Drain the sausage skillet promptly; turkey sausage renders less fat than pork but it still sets up if left to cool in the pan.
leftovers: Store sausage and egg whites separately from muffins to avoid sogginess.
Reheat sausage and eggs covered at 300°F for 8 minutes, then rebuild sandwiches fresh.

adaptable.label: Gluten-Free Adaptable
adaptable.note: Use a certified gluten-free bun/bread and toast on a separate, clean surface.

adaptable.label: Dairy-Free Adaptable
adaptable.note: Use a dairy-free cheese shred/block alternative. Use a plant-based butter/margarine.
